delta_registered.units: exact-set accuracy, same scale as every score in the family
delta_registered.fixed: NUMERIC AND FIXED NOW. ⛔ Never a judgement call again (Head condition (a)).
delta_registered.derivation: the metric grain is 1/512 = 0.001953125 (512 unseen queries/seed); δ = 0.01 ≈ 5.12 grains, i.e. a score within δ of chance is inside measurement noise of the floor. It is also 10× BELOW K5's own margin bar (0.10) and 60× below K3's bar (0.60), so a genuine near-miss can never be abstained away.
delta_registered.measured_headroom_at_this_cell: max(top_physics_score − chance) over the three claim seeds = 0.001953125 = ONE grain — 5.1× inside δ.

discrimination_test.rule: A leg is NON-DISCRIMINATING (discriminated = false ⇒ ABSTAIN) iff, on the arm it was scored on, it was structurally incapable of producing both outcomes.
discrimination_test.K5_specific_rule: K5 abstains iff BOTH (i) the per-item table scores ≤ chance + δ AND (ii) the arm's best read scores ≤ chance + δ.
discrimination_test.⚠_hub_amendment_to_the_head_s_literal_wo: The Head's condition (a) states the table half only. The Hub registers the CONJUNCTION, which is STRICTLY NARROWER (it abstains LESS often, never more). Reason: a cell with a floor-level table and a STRONG read is fully discriminating and must PASS — under the table-only rule it would abstain and a genuine positive would be silently discarded. That is the mirror image of the very defect §A37 names, so the table-only form would reintroduce the class it was written to close. ⛔ This narrows the abstain; it cannot be used to widen it.
discrimination_test.abstain_semantics: ABSTAIN = neither unlocks nor blocks — the route-3 precedent already registered in PREREG-C2W11.md §4 for K1, now generalized per Head condition (b).
discrimination_test.generalization: ⛔ NOT a K5 special case. Every leg carries `discriminated`, and the gate is computed over the discriminating legs only, so the same defect on any other leg is caught by the same machinery (Head condition (b)).
